webster.text: A state of being not dependent; complete exemption from control, or the power of others; as the independence of the Supreme Being.

more.text: A state in which a person does not rely on others for subsistence; ability to support one's self.
A state of mind in which a person acts without bias or influence from others; exemption from undue influence; self-direction.

example.quote: Were the executive magistrate, or the judges, not independent of the legislature in this particular, their independence in every other would be merely nominal.
